title: EchoQA: A Large Collection of Instruction Tuning Data for Echocardiogram Reports

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the F1 equality difference metric (average absolute difference between subgroup F1 and overall F1) across demographic groups discretized by census tract-level data for unemployment rates and household reliance on public assistance.
Calculating the F1 equality difference metric across demographic groups discretized by census tract-level data for the percentage of the population living with a disability.
Calculating the F1 equality difference metric across demographic groups discretized by census tract-level data for the percentage of adults reporting 14 or more days of poor mental health per month.
Calculating the F1 equality difference metric across demographic groups discretized by census tract-level data for the percentages of adults who are heavy drinkers and current smokers.
